_comment: Polled by client_patch/dustdevhook.py once the merc quarters are loaded; bump revision to run the commands again. Actions: ue3, init_battle_services, offline_battle_connect, mark_in_battle, notify, battle_member ({credential, characterID, characterURI, name, team}: lets a second client join this listen server), call ({"service","method","args"}), sleep. revision 0 = nothing. Current recipe: multiplayer host. Local Ambush on Craters BG01 as a UE3 listen server (?listen, UDP 7777), then the deploy map; press Triangle (Smart Deploy) to spawn. battle_member registers the second client (port 8081) with a fixed credential; it joins with dev_commands_8081.json. PlayerControllerClass=DustDevPlayerController enables dev console commands (SetCloneReservesForTeam, SpawnInstallationByType, SpawnByType, SpawnAI, ...).
